meta.title: About Focuspilot | Our Story & Mission
meta.description: Learn about Focuspilot - the team building AI-powered project management software for interior designers. Our mission is to give designers more time to design.

aboutPage.title: About Focuspilot
aboutPage.paragraph1: We're building the modern operating system for interior design studios. Our mission is simple: give designers more time to design by automating the admin.
aboutPage.paragraph2: Founded in 2026, Focuspilot combines deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge AI to create tools that actually understand how design studios work.

meta.title: Careers at Focuspilot | Join Our Team
meta.description: Join the Focuspilot team. We're building AI-powered software for interior designers and looking for passionate people to help us grow.

careersPage.title: Careers at Focuspilot
careersPage.intro: We're building tools that help interior designers focus on what they love. Join us if you're passionate about great software and beautiful design.
careersPage.noOpenings: We're a small, growing team. While we don't have open positions listed right now, we're always interested in hearing from talented people.

meta.title: Customer Stories | Interior Designers Using Focuspilot
meta.description: See how interior design studios use Focuspilot to save time and grow their business. Real stories from real designers.

hero.title: Loved by design studios
hero.subtitle: See how interior designers and architects use Focuspilot to save time, delight clients, and focus on what they do best.

sarahMitchell.quote: Focuspilot has transformed how we manage projects. The AI features alone save us 10+ hours a week on admin work that used to consume my evenings.
sarahMitchell.author: Sarah Mitchell

jamesChen.quote: Finally, software that actually understands how interior design studios work. The client portal is beautiful and our clients love being able to approve selections online.
jamesChen.author: James Chen

emmaWilliams.quote: We switched from Programa and haven't looked back. The Xero integration works flawlessly and procurement tracking has eliminated our spreadsheet chaos.
emmaWilliams.author: Emma Williams

marcusThompson.quote: The onboarding was smooth and the support team genuinely understands design practice. They've built features we didn't even know we needed.
marcusThompson.author: Marcus Thompson

lisaPark.quote: Managing FF&E schedules used to be a nightmare. Now our whole team can see what's ordered, what's shipped, and what's installed in real-time.
lisaPark.author: Lisa Park

davidOkonkwo.quote: The AI proposal generator paid for the entire subscription in the first month. It's scarily accurate at estimating project timelines and costs.
davidOkonkwo.author: David Okonkwo

meta.title: Integrations | Connect Your Tools | Focuspilot
meta.description: Connect Focuspilot with Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Calendar, Gmail, Zapier, and more. All integrations included on every plan.

hero.title: Integrations
hero.subtitle: Connect Focuspilot with the tools you already use. Automate your workflow and keep everything in sync.
hero.note: All integrations included on every plan.

xero.description: Two-way sync for invoices, payments, and expenses. Keep your books up to date automatically.

quickbooks.description: Sync invoices and payments automatically. Works with QuickBooks Online.

stripe.description: Accept client payments through the portal. Automatic reconciliation with invoices.

googleCalendar.description: Sync project milestones, meetings, and deadlines to your calendar.

outlookCalendar.description: Keep your Outlook calendar in sync with project timelines and appointments.

gmail.description: Connect Gmail in Studio Integrations for AI Inbox — categorised email, summaries, and suggested actions in one workspace.

zapier.description: Studio API keys, signed webhooks, and REST endpoints for projects and clients. Trigger Zaps on new projects, clients, and invoices.

notion.description: Connect your Notion workspace, browse shared databases, and sync rows into Focuspilot projects — names and status stay up to date.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.subtitle: We're always adding new integrations. Have a request? Let us know.

finalCta.title: Connect everything you use
finalCta.subtitle: All integrations are included on every plan. Start free and connect your tools.
